text_block_list.text:
Марузенски has a great time running the

Japanese Derby, a race that
Umamusume only run
once in their lives.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I suggest that she challenge
the Arima
Kinen next, the best place to
show her running to
the world.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The suggestion surprises her, but she
agrees and
sets her sights on the Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
